title: Beyond gamma gap and albumin/globulin ratio: an exploratory cross-survey protein-coupling test
abstract: Adding a source-centered albumin × globulin term beyond flexible conventional measures, gamma gap and albumin/globulin ratio changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.168734 to 0.168753 (delta +0.000020; approximate joint source/target PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000063,+0.000134]). Incremental improvement was not established. NHANES III source models were transported without target tuning to NHANES2017–2018 adults. This is a functional-representation test on previously explored surveys, not untouched confirmation or a new biomarker.
